decision.reason: [ev-f64f7c540c6d] says only that the flag `endpoint-status` has been removed. It points to "the following Helm upgrade notes" for details, but those notes are not among the evidence shown. Nothing in the evidence says whether a remaining `--endpoint-status` setting is silently ignored, is rejected so the agent fails to start, or is handled by Helm. So the proposed "will be ignored" consequence (setting-ignored, action-required) is unsupported, and no other consequence kind can be settled. The referenced Helm upgrade notes for endpoint-status/endpointStatus in 1.16 are needed.
